cells.reason: As presented, the anchor is Directive 2009/48/EC toy-material migration ('toys and toy components (soluble element migration)', EN 71-3 category III, mg/kg of material), a migration basis and a non-food scope, so tests (a) and (b) both fail for a food-content cell. The record is also internally inconsistent: its regulatory_limit_id, URL, notes and row hash belong to the GSO 193:2021 'Muscle meat of fish with exception mentioned' row (verified in regulatory_limits.csv as GSO, muscle meat, as_sold, 50), while jurisdiction, authority, basis, product_scope and regulation_page are the EU toy directive, and no EN 71-3 cadmium migration limit equals 50 ug/kg (the categories are 1300 / 300 / 17000). The evidence record needs repair; even read as the GSO fish row it does not cover canned tuna (GSO tuna 100; see the e8b5dd23b9f12a25 verdict), so the blind gov value for the cell as scoped is 100.
